execution_provenance.claim_scope: State-machine ordering, transcript binding, hostile-input rejection, atomic commit, credential quarantine, and failure behavior only. This is not a target runtime, cycle, or RAM result.

covered_security_properties: Complete server-flight AEAD verification precedes plaintext parsing.
Server Finished verification precedes Client Finished emission.
Only one immutable credential-free HEAD can be outstanding.
Redirects, interim responses, Upgrade, bodies, overlap, oversize, unsolicited data, KeyUpdate, post-handshake authentication, alerts, and unexpected epochs or inner types are rejected.
KEM and identity proofs are transcript-bound and all TLS material is rederived and compared before atomic promotion.
The first tentative ticket may survive peer close only after proof; bounded extra tickets are validated and discarded.
Post-Finished KEM, leaf, and CertificateVerify failures expose the same public trace and close action.
Application sequence numbers continue across commit; credentials and real requests become reachable only after live commit.
limitations: The KEM and identity proof booleans are deterministic oracle inputs; independent ML-KEM and ECDSA known-answer gates remain required.
No Seed product source, 8088 code, 16 KiB runtime, timing path, or target memory layout is exercised.
